import os,glob,re
def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def f(g):
    g=np.array(g); bg=Counter(g.flatten().tolist()).most_common(1)[0][0]

    lab,n=ndimage.label(mask)  # 4-connectivity

        r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()

            blk=out[r0+1:r1,c0+1:c1]; blk[m]=fill; out[r0+1:r1,c0+1:c1]=blk
    return out.tolist()
